offering_description.value: Operates electronic over-the-counter marketplaces (OTCQX, OTCQB, Pink) for trading U.S. and international securities not listed on exchanges. Sells data licensing and market data to financial institutions, and corporate services to issuers. Delivers through its own trading platforms (OTC Link ATS) and data feeds.

primary_products.value: market data feeds and licenses; compliance and disclosure data products; issuer market tiers

primary_services.value: electronic securities trading platform (ATS); issuer corporate services and disclosure distribution; market data distribution

customer_segment.value: B2B: public companies (issuers), broker-dealers, banks, data vendors, institutional investors

end_markets.value: financial services; capital markets; securities trading

revenue_model.value: subscription: annual and recurring fees from issuers on OTCQX and OTCQB; licensing or royalties: market data licensing to vendors and financial institutions; transaction or usage fees: OTC Link ATS and broker-dealer connectivity fees
revenue_model.category: subscription; licensing or royalties; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: operates trading venues connecting broker-dealers and issuers with investors; software / platform: runs electronic trading and data platforms sold to financial firms and issuers

geography_served.value: global: U.S.-based, issuers and brokers from many countries trade on its markets

specialization.value: related lines: OTC markets, market data licensing and corporate services for issuers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to issuers, data clients and broker-dealers; online: websites and electronic data feeds

regulatory_exposure.value: high: SEC-registered broker-dealer and alternative trading system, regulated by SEC and FINRA
